en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large alpine-style building complex labeled "Erzgebirgsheim Wald-Bärenburg" set among tall coniferous trees and forested hills. A road and grassy foreground lead to the multi‑storey structures, which have steep tiled roofs and many windows. The image has printed German text at the top describing the location and elevation in the Eastern Ore Mountains.
